_readme: Server-side strings that reach players: GameError messages, server-authored feed/flavor text (server/resources.ts). Keys are referenced as server.<key>.

err.dbStarting: The preserve database is starting up — restart Harper if this persists.
err.positiveWholeNumber: {label} must be a positive whole number
err.noSaveLogin: No save found — please log in again
err.nameLength: Pick a name between 2 and 24 characters
err.passcodeLength: Pick a passcode of at least 4 characters
err.nameNeedsAlnum: That name needs at least one letter or number
err.saveExists: A save with that name already exists
err.noSaveWithName: No save found with that name
err.passcodeMismatch: That passcode doesn't match this save
err.newPasscodeLength: Pick a new passcode between 4 and 32 characters
err.noSaveTryNew: No save found with that name — try New Game
err.worldNameLength: Pick a world name under 40 characters
err.noWorldWithCode: No world found with that code
err.hostNotApproved: The host hasn’t approved you for this world yet
err.worldFullJoined: This preserve is full — {max} caretakers have joined and it's closed to new players.
err.worldFullClosed: This preserve is full — it already has its {max} caretakers and is closed to new players.
err.onlyHostApproves: Only the host can approve players
err.requestNotPending: That request is no longer pending
err.notWorldMember: You are not a member of that world
err.cannotLeaveSolo: You cannot leave your own solo world
err.notInWorld: You are not in that world
err.weatherOnly: {resource} only appears in certain weather here
err.regrowing: This spot is still regrowing — come back soon
err.basketFullStore: Your basket is full — store materials in a chest first
err.discardTooMany: You do not have that many to throw away
err.plantedNotCrafted: {name} is planted, not crafted — dig a bed, water it, and plant it.
err.needsProperHouse: {name} needs a proper house — upgrade your home's Space first.
err.recipeBiomeLocked: This recipe unlocks with a biome you have not restored yet
err.craftOnce: You have already crafted the {name} — it only needs to be made once.
err.kitNotPlaceable: {name} is a kit, not a placeable object
err.noneCrafted: You have no crafted {name} to place
err.outOfReach: That spot is out of reach
err.outdoorOnly: {name} belongs out in the preserve, not indoors
err.needsBiggerHome: {name} needs a bigger home — upgrade your home's Space first.
err.placeOnFloor: Place it on the floor inside your home
err.indoorOnly: {name} cannot be placed out in the preserve
err.openOcean: That is open ocean — build on the shore
err.openWaterBridge: That is open water — a wooden bridge can span it
err.bedForPlanting: That soil bed is for planting — or clear it with the shovel
err.bridgeNeedsWater: Bridges go over open water — flood a channel first
err.wouldNotTakeRoot: {name} would not take root in the {biome}
err.plantIntoWatered: Plant into a watered soil bed — dig with the shovel, then water it
err.workbenchStays: Your crafting station stays put — the preserve needs it
err.openWaterBridgeOnly: That is open water — only a bridge can sit there
err.bedForPlantingShort: That soil bed is for planting
err.emptyChestFirst: Empty the chest before picking it up
err.noRoomRefund: No room for the refunded materials — make space in your basket or a chest first
err.buildStyleFirst: Build your home in a style first.
err.trackMaxed: Your home's {track} is already at its finest.
err.needBedToRest: Craft and place a sleeping bag or bed in your home first.
err.buildBeforeRepaint: Build your home before you can repaint it.
err.buildBeforeRepaintThings: Build your home before you can repaint your things.
err.homeAlreadyBuilt: Your home is already built — choose upgrades from here.
err.animalNotReturned: That animal has not returned yet
err.taskNotOnBoard: That task is not on today's board
err.taskAlreadyClaimed: Already claimed — fresh tasks arrive tomorrow
err.taskNotFinished: Not finished yet — check the board for what remains
err.basketFullReward: Your basket is full — make room for the reward first
err.terraformOutdoors: You can only shape the ground out in the preserve
err.needShovel: You need your shovel for that
err.alreadyPrepared: This ground is already prepared — water it, or clear it instead
err.needWateringCan: You need your watering can for that
err.prepareBedFirst: Prepare a soil bed with your shovel first
err.tooDryToFlood: {biome} is too dry to flood — soil beds here can only be readied for planting.
err.needWater: You need {count} water for that — gather more first
err.notExplorable: {biome} is part of the preserve plan but not explorable yet
err.noSaveWithId: No save found with that id
err.snapshotPathId: Add a player id to the path: /BiomeSnapshot/<playerId>
err.meadowCannotLock: The starting meadow cannot be locked
err.feedbackEmpty: Please write a little something first
err.feedbackBadEmail: That reply email doesn’t look right — leave it blank if you don’t want a response

task.welcomeGrasshopperHint: Craft and place a grass patch, then bring the meadow to 15% health — the grasshopper hops home on its own.
task.welcomeNewAnimal: Welcome a new animal back to {biome}
task.welcomeAnyAnimal: Welcome a new animal, anywhere in the preserve
task.observe: Read about 3 animals in your journal

whyReturned.sentence: Felt safe enough to return once {reasons}.
